name: manual_5bbeb5
claim: Redact an append-only SQLite board record with an index-aware update (FTS5 delete with the exact old values, update, reinsert) after a backup, and post a correction note.

decisions.notes: The gossip table has an external-content FTS index with insert and delete triggers but no update trigger, so a plain UPDATE leaves the leaked text searchable.

rationale: The gossip table has an external-content FTS index with insert and delete triggers but no update trigger, so a plain UPDATE leaves the leaked text searchable.
